title: scorzonera laciniata var. latifolia
intro: Scorzonera laciniata var. latifolia, commonly known as White Salsify, is a perennial plant belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include aiding digestion, reducing inflammation, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of White Salsify are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. Bioactive constituents of White Salsify include inulin, a prebiotic fiber, as well as phenolic compounds and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
